title: Leaf rectangles of a protocol are monochromatic
statement: Let $p$ be a deterministic two-party communication protocol over input types $X$ and $Y$ with output type $\alpha$, and let $g : X \to Y \to \alpha$ be a function that $p$ computes, meaning that running $p$ on any pair of inputs $(x, y)$ returns $g\,x\,y$. Then every leaf rectangle $R$ of $p$ is monochromatic for $g$: the value $g\,x\,y$ is the same for all $(x, y) \in R$.
hypotheses_covered: p is a deterministic communication protocol over X, Y with output type α
g : X → Y → α is a function
R is a leaf rectangle of p
replaced:
If $p$ computes $g : X \to Y \to \alpha$ and $R \in \texttt{leafRectangles}(p)$, then $R$ is
$g$-monochromatic: all inputs in $R$ receive the same value of $g$.
